prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info changes are helpful, with 3 winning tests out of 6.
Choose_path copy updates and redesigns showed no clear effect or performed worse across 2 tests each.
Finish hints and sign-in notifications showed no clear positive effect, ranging from no effect to performing worse across 2 tests each.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories, including adoption redesigns, adoption wait_info, choose_path hints/layouts, finish layouts/new_flows/redesigns, home new_flows, and sign-in redesigns/reordering.
Predictions were systematically too low for winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative results.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Live Generation Progress Checklist Display: Adds a stage-by-stage generation checklist component to the waiting screen to show real-time pet rendering status. (why: Home wait time has a high mean (2336s), and home wait_info changes have been historically effective (3 winning tests out of 6).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Sound & Voice Command Intro Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen right before final completion to teach desktop audio and voice interaction controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Archetype Stage Layout Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen into a multi-stage layout showcasing character archetypes with distinct trait callouts. (why: Adoption has a 25.2% dropoff rate and high completion time (median 89s / mean 1017s).)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Sound & Stage Progress Wait Info: Adds an ambient sound player and progress delay timer to keep users engaged on the waiting screen. (why: Wait info modifications on the home waiting screen have consistently yielded positive results in previous iterations.)
4: [sign_in, redesign] Multi-Pet Account Restore Sign-In Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen to emphasize existing pet account restoration and multi-pet sync protection. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account clarity crucial.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control & Docking Interactive Flow: Introduces a step-by-step interactive flow on home_intro covering desktop pet docking, hiding, and shortcut actions. (why: 7 total support emails cited post-onboarding confusion regarding controls or desktop feature misbehavior.)
6: [home, notification] Pet Ready Desktop Alert Notification Settings: Enables an explicit desktop notification toggle and status update on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting mean duration is 2336s; notifying users on desktop brings them back when creation completes.)
7: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Controls & Docking Split Redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a two-column layout separating desktop docking hints from general pet interaction guidelines. (why: Multiple support emails note confusion around managing pets on desktop after finishing onboarding.)
